I look forward to delivering him to you.|Jedi General Luminara Unduli and Captain Faro Argyus|audio=LuminaraChecksIn-CoD.flac|}} The '''''Tranquility''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], wherein it served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was dispatched to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in the aftermath of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Alongside [[General/Legends|General]] Unduli, [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], a contingent of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corp]], and a [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], the ''Tranquility'' was to transport Gunray from Rodia to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he would stand trial for war crimes. Just as the ''Tranquility'' began its journey, it was accosted by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]]. Despite the efforts of the Star Destroyer's [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], the boarding [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were able to pierce the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} [[Hull/Legends|hull]], deploying [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] alongside [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a Confederate [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] tasked with [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|freeing]] Gunray from Republic captivity. Although the Republic forces aboard the ''Tranquility'' were able to repel the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Ventress crippled the Star Destroyer by setting off [[Thermal detonator/Legends|explosives]] within its main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] room. This, in addition to the betrayal of a [[Faro Argyus/Legends|member]] of the Senate Commandos, allowed Gunray to escape the detention level, flee the ''Tranquility'', and return to Confederate [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. After a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] in the destroyed reactor room, Ventress escaped the ''Tranquility'' as well aboard one of its [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], joining the fleeing Gunray and leaving the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic Navy with a heavily damaged Star Destroyer. ==Description== [[File:Tranquility.png|thumb|left|250px|The ventral surface of the ''Tranquility''.]] Like all [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], the ''Tranquility'' retained dual [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]], [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], a lengthy dorsal flight deck, and a ventral [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] for larger [[Starship/Legends|ships]] such as [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigates]]. The exterior of the vessel sported numerous [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], the insignia of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]], and the red markings common to ships of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. The interior of the ''Tranquility'' had a high-security [[Detention area|detention level]] with several cells that were all protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shields]] capable of withstanding [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes. These shields were controlled by panels on the bulkhead next to the cells. At the entrance to the detention level was a control panel that provided readouts on the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} systems and status. The detention level could be accessed by [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]], or unconventionally via the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} ventilation shafts. The main engine room had several vertical [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]] with walkways stretching on different levels, providing access for onboard personnel. In addition, large pipes that carried [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] to the reactors ran along the ceiling of the engine room.{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness|d=y}} ==History== ===Prisoner transport=== {{Quote|Gunray's capture could be a serious threat to us, my friend. The viceroy will not last long under Jedi interrogation.''"
"''I have already put a plan into action, my lord. My best agent, Asajj Ventress, will infiltrate the Jedi ship, and either free Gunray, or silence him.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and Darth Tyranus|audio=FreeGunrayOrSilenceHim-CoD.flac|}} [[File:Gunray_and_Tano.png|thumb|right|270px|Ahsoka Tano outside Nute Gunray's cell.]] The ''Tranquility'' was a ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in the service of the Republic Navy during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, the vessel acted as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].{{SWE|characters|luminaraunduli|Luminara Unduli}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the ''Tranquility'' was dispatched to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in the aftermath of [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|the capture]] of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], the [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and a leading member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. Following a failed attempt to bring Rodia into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fold, the viceroy was captured by the Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} The ''Tranquility'', carrying a contingent of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]], was to collect Gunray from Rodia and transport him to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he would stand trial for his war crimes. While the ''Tranquility'' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the planet, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]], nicknamed "Gree," led the 41st Elite Legion to the surface to relieve the senators of Gunray and take the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] into custody. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were joined by [[General/Legends|General]] Unduli and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to ensure safe passage for the ''Tranquility''. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] concluded business on Rodia, and the ''Tranquility'' received a complement of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]],''[[The Clone Wars: Transfer]]'' an undercover Confederate agent. With all of the viceroy's escorts in place, Gunray was ferried up to the ''Tranquility'' aboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Rodia)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigate]]. The [[Cruiser/Legends|vessel]] docked in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} ventral docking bay, unloading Gunray and his Jedi and clone escorts. The Neimoidian was taken to the vessel's detention level and placed inside a [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-shielded holding cell, guarded by the Senate Commandos and Gree. As the ''Tranquility'' departed from Rodia's orbit, Unduli and Tano began their interrogation of Gunray. However, unbeknownst to both Gunray and the Republic forces aboard the ''Tranquility'', the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], had dispatched [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|infiltrate]] the ''Tranquility'' and either rescue or [[Death/Legends|kill]] Gunray in order to prevent him from leaking information to the Republic. Before the Star Destroyer was able to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] out of [[Tyrius system/Legends|the system]], Ventress arrived in Rodian [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and ambushed the ''Tranquility'' with a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. In addition to the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]], three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] headed for the Star Destroyer, and despite the attempts of the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to shoot the attacking ships down, the craft lodged themselves in the cruiser's [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. As the boarding ships began to disgorge [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] into the Star Destroyer's dorsal flight deck, the 41st Elite's [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] engaged the invaders. The Republic [[Company/Legends|unit]] was decimated, and the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] continued toward the detention level. As Republic forces under Unduli and Gree continued to combat the droids in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} corridors, Ventress, who had been aboard one of the boarding ships, entered the flight deck and sneaked into the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} ventilation shafts. From these shafts, she was able to access the Star Destroyer's reactor room, where she planted numerous [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] while avoiding the sight of [[327-T/Legends|327-T]], a [[WED-15 Treadwell droid/Legends|WED-15 Treadwell]] droid that was inspecting the area. After planting the timed explosives, Ventress returned to the ventilation shafts and proceeded to the detention level. With the Republic forces believing that the initial Separatist attack had been repelled, Ventress was able to quickly overpower Tano and the Senate Commandos guarding the Viceroy and free Gunray from his holding cell. However, the Dark Acolyte's progress was quickly halted with the return of Unduli and Gree from the fight in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} corridors. Unduli joined Tano in her struggle against Ventress shortly before the Dark Acolyte's apparent surrender. ===Crippled=== {{Quote|Everything's running haywire. Doors, lifts, communication's down. Propulsion's dead. She's crippled the entire ship.|Faro Argyus, on Asajj Ventress's sabotage of the ''Tranquility''|audio=EverythingRunningHaywire-CoD.flac|}} [[File:Reactor_boom.png|thumb|left|270px|The ''Tranquility''{{'s}} reactors are destroyed.]] Ventress had no intention of surrendering to the Jedi, however, and her timed explosives went off. The reactor room was engulfed in flames as the thermal detonators destroyed the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} engines, door and turbolift controls, and communication systems. The blast shook the entire vessel, allowing Ventress to escape the Jedi and flee to the ruined reactor room via a turbolift shaft. Unduli gave chase while Tano remained with Gree and Argyus to guard Gunray, who was returned to his cell. Ventress was able to ambush and overpower Unduli during a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] in the reactor room and nearly killed her after severing several large pipes from the ceiling. The pipes slammed to the floor, pinning Unduli's leg to the ground. However, Tano decided to disobey her orders and follow Unduli into the reactor room, and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was able to save the Jedi Master from Ventress and free her leg. Ventress, having distracted the Jedi away from Gunray, signaled Argyus via her wrist [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]]. The captain received the signal and promptly killed his fellow commandos before opening fire on Gree. The clone commander attempted to return fire, but Argyus used Gunray as a living shield by pushing the viceroy between himself and the clone. Gree, unable to fire on enemy [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], instead entered into a brief fist fight with Argyus, but the combined forces of the traitorous Senate Commando and the viceroy knocked the clone unconscious. All obstacles removed, Gunray and Argyus fled to the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} ventral docking bay, where they commandeered the ''Consular''-class cruiser originally used to bring them aboard. With the ''Tranquility'' still crippled from the blast, the cruiser made an easy getaway. Ventress fled the reactor room after detonating several more explosives and made her way to the Star Destroyer's escape pod bays, where she killed several clone troopers before escaping the ''Tranquility'' in one of its lifepods. The ''Tranquility'' was later repaired at the [[Outer Rim Command Center/Legends|Outer Rim Command Center]],{{TCW|Lair of Grievous|d=y}} allowing Unduli and Tano to report their failure and the loss of Gunray to Jedi Generals [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. In the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} war room, the four discussed the [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|continuing pursuit]] of the viceroy by Jedi General [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], who was able to track the stolen Republic ship via its [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]]. Shortly afterward, Tano left the Star Destroyer before Unduli and the ''Tranquility'' departed Rodian space. ==Commanders and crew== {{Dialogue|Trooper|You keep watch here, 327.|327-T|<annoyed beeps>|Trooper|Okay, okay. 327-''T''.|Captain|You know droids never like to be called by their nicknames.|attr=[[Unidentified clone trooper (Tranquility)/Legends|A clone trooper]], 327-T, and a [[Unidentified Clone Captain (Tranquility)/Legends|clone captain]]|audio=327T-CoD.flac|src=}} [[File:327-t.png|thumb|right|200px|327-T]] As a vessel in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars, the ''Tranquility'' was heavily crewed by clones. The [[Unidentified clone naval captain/Legends|captain]] of the vessel was a clone who was present on the bridge during the Confederacy's rescue of Viceroy Nute Gunray alongside other [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] who worked as gunners. As her flagship, the vessel was under the overall command of Jedi General Luminara Unduli, with Commanders Ahsoka Tano and Gree serving with her. With Gunray as a prisoner, the ''Tranquility'' received a complement of Senate Commandos, a security measure not commonly afforded away from Coruscant. The ship was patrolled by at least one WED-15 Treadwell droid, designated "327-T." The Treadwell droid was in the reactor room when Ventress planted her explosives, but was unable to spot her. He was later buried beneath rubble when the explosives detonated, only to be found by Unduli and Tano during their search for Ventress. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Tranquility'' first appeared in the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, where it served as the setting for the episode titled "[[Cloak of Darkness]]." The ship also appeared in the young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]'', and its damaged reactor room was a level in the 2008 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]'', in which players could reenact the duel between Ventress and Unduli. The catwalks and columns in the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} engine room were designed by the episode's creators to be an architectural nod to the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] control room of the Super Dimensional Fortress from the [[Wikipedia:Macross|''Macross'' anime series]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi in Training]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi Adventures]]'' *{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}} {{1stID|''Tranquility''}} *{{TCW|Jedi Crash}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== {{ScrollBox|content= {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tranquility}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode008.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bombad Jedi}} {{Imo}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}} *{{CSWECite|I||Argyus, Captain}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 5.7|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 5.7]] *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' {{Po}} *''[[The Clone Wars: Forces of Darkness]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' {{Po}} *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#30: Luminara Unduli|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW30_Luminara.asp}} *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2009 Basic Figure|pack=#31: Captain Argyus|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW31_Argyus.asp}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition in-game databank}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Jedi Heroes]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' *{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep109|text="Cloak of Darkness" -
